verificationNotes: Audit 2026-04-12: the conductor monitor remains mounted as a dedicated dashboard navigation item in src/dashboard/lib/navigation.tsx, backed by the existing ConductorTracksMonitor surface in src/dashboard/components/dashboard/ConductorTracksMonitor.tsx. Focused verification passed for npm run build, npm run build:ui, and npx vitest run --config vitest.dashboard.config.ts src/dashboard/lib/navigation.contract.test.ts.
